parameters.content:
## Product data enrichment

Scrapes each queued product's manufacturer spec page, has an AI model return every attribute with a confidence, a source label and an exact quote, checks each quote in code, and asks you in Slack about anything it isn't sure of. Approved values go to `custom.*` metafields and, where Shopify's taxonomy has the attribute, to the product's category metafield.

### How it works
1. **Setup** (run once) creates four data tables, saves your attribute schema, creates the metafield definitions and turns on the category value types.
2. **Extract** (every 15 minutes) takes products tagged `enrich`, scrapes the spec page (Firecrawl when a site blocks plain requests), adds an optional product database and image text, extracts the values and approves grounded ones from the spec page or database.
3. **Review** posts a card per product with every value editable, plus a bulk card per category and attribute. Clicks are signature-checked.
4. **Push** writes approved values with `metafieldsSet`, proves each write and retries failures one at a time. `dry_run` is on until you turn it off.

### Setup
1. Credentials: Custom Auth (Shopify client ID and secret) on the three **Get Shopify token** nodes, Slack API on **Post the card** and **Update the card**, Crypto (Slack signing secret) on **Sign the request**, Ollama on both chat models, Header Auth on **Firecrawl scrape** if you use it.
2. Fill in the four settings nodes; your categories and attributes go in `schema`.
3. Run **Run once to set up**.
4. Point your Slack app's Interactivity URL at **Slack button click**.
5. Test with a few IDs in `product_ids`, then publish.

### Customisation
- Swap either chat model sub-node for any other.
- Turn on **Product database (optional)** for your industry's database.
- Set `use_images` to true to read specs printed on product photos.

## Setup (run once)
Creates the four data tables, saves the attribute schema from **Setup settings**, creates a pinned metafield definition per attribute (usable in smart collections) and turns on the Shopify category value types the schema names. Safe to run again.

## Extract (every 15 minutes)
One product at a time: scrape the spec page (Firecrawl when a plain request is blocked), add the optional database and image text, label the sources, ask the model, then check every quote in code. Confident values from the spec page or a database are approved; the rest wait for review. Removes the `enrich` tag.

## Review (Slack)
Posts a bulk card per category and attribute, and a card per product with every pending value editable. Clicks are checked against Slack's signature; an approval sends the values straight to Push.

## Push (every 15 minutes, and after each approval)
Writes approved values to `custom.*` metafields and, where the category has the attribute, to its category metafield. Proves every write. Nothing is written while `dry_run` is true.

### Writes to Shopify
Creates metafield definitions and turns on category value types. Test on a development store first.

### Writes to Shopify
Removes the `enrich` tag once a product is extracted.

### Writes to Shopify
Creates category value entries (metaobjects). Only runs when `dry_run` is false.

### Writes to Shopify
Sets product metafields. Nothing is written until `dry_run` is false in **Push settings**. Test on a development store first.
